sections.name: Toaster
sections.title: Draws the current toasts
sections.what: Reads the current toast list and draws each toast with its title, description, optional action and close button, plus the viewport.
sections.why: Likely reason: one component displays every toast that other code requests.
sections.watch_out: Each toast uses its id as its key, so two toasts with the same id could show the wrong content.

summary: The component that draws every active popup message from the toast system.
purpose: Shows the toast messages that other code asks for.
why: Likely reason: one place draws all toasts. The reason is not otherwise stated.
how: Gets the list of active toasts from the useToast hook. For each one, draws a toast with its title, description, optional action and a close button. Adds the viewport once at the end.
inputs: The list of active toasts from the useToast hook.
outputs: Rendered toast messages on the page.
risks: Everything it shows depends on the hook, so a bug in the hook shows up here.
debug: If no toasts show, check that the hook is updating and that the toaster is on the page. If a toast is missing its text, check its title and description values.
